MAIS.SO_TEXTO: Outside the 24 hours the reply goes through the backup number, as text only. Photos, audio and documents don't go.

ERROS.nomeDaLista: Write the name of the button that opens the list.
ERROS.coordenadas: Place not found. Paste the numbers from Google Maps, like -23.5613, -46.6565.
ERROS.telefone: Type a phone number that exists in the chosen country, with area code.
ERROS.mensagemLonga: The message is too long for this format. Shorten it a bit.
ERROS.nomeDoBotaoLongo: The button name can have up to 20 characters.
ERROS.enderecoInvalido: Paste the full website address, starting with https://
ERROS.opcaoLonga: Each option can have up to 20 characters.
ERROS.opcaoDaListaLonga: In a list, each option can have up to 24 characters.
ERROS.opcoesRepetidas: Some options are the same. Write each one differently.
ERROS.nomeDaListaLongo: The list button name can have up to 20 characters.
ERROS.nomeDoLugarLongo: The place name can have up to 100 characters.
ERROS.enderecoDoLugarLongo: The address can have up to 300 characters.
ERROS.nomeDoContatoLongo: The name can have up to 100 characters.
ERROS.textoDoBotaoLongo: The button text can have up to 30 characters.

BOTAO_DE_LINK.AJUDA: The customer taps the button and opens the website.

OPCOES.AJUDA: The customer replies with one tap. Up to 3 options become buttons; more than that, a list.
OPCOES.NOME_DA_LISTA_AJUDA: With more than 3 options, the customer taps this button to see the list.

LOCALIZACAO.AJUDA: The customer gets the place on a map.
LOCALIZACAO.COORDENADAS: Where it is on the map
LOCALIZACAO.COORDENADAS_AJUDA: In Google Maps, right-click the place and click the numbers to copy them. A Google Maps link also works.
LOCALIZACAO.BUSCAR: Search the address or the place name
LOCALIZACAO.BUSCAR_EXEMPLO: E.g.: 1000 Paulista Ave or Example Store
LOCALIZACAO.ESCOLHA_UM: Pick an address from the list.
LOCALIZACAO.TENHO_COORDENADAS: Not found? Use the Google Maps coordinates

PEDIDO_DE_LOCALIZACAO.AJUDA: The customer gets a button to send where they are.
PEDIDO_DE_LOCALIZACAO.PADRAO: Could you send me your location?

CONTATO.AJUDA: The customer gets the card and can chat with this number.
CONTATO.TELEFONE_AJUDA: Choose the country and type the number with area code.
CONTATO.NOME_EXEMPLO: Search your contacts or type a name
CONTATO.NOME_AJUDA: Pick a contact and the phone comes along.

FORMULARIO.AJUDA: The customer taps the button and fills it in inside WhatsApp. Only released forms show up. Do not use a form that asks for a password: the answer shows in the conversation.
FORMULARIO.NENHUM: This inbox has no approved form on Meta yet.

JANELA.AJUDA_TEXTO: On this number the customer gets it as text. The preview shows how it looks.
JANELA.ERRO_GERAL: Couldn't send right now. Try again in a moment.

PREVIA.VIRA_TEXTO: On this number the customer gets it as text, like this:

JANELA_FECHADA.TEXTO: It has been 24 hours since the customer last wrote. To talk to them again, send a template.

GRAVACAO.SEM_MICROFONE: The browser did not allow the microphone. Click the lock next to the site address and allow the microphone.
